title: Flight safety with physics-verified dynamics: a drone that says what is wrong with it
description: A 1.5 kg quad-X with four BEMT rotors, a pack that sags and a cascaded controller flies while eight faults are injected at t = 8 s, one per flight: payload, degraded motor, chipped blade, gust, GPS glitch, magnetometer interference, IMU vibration and battery sag. The Newton-Euler residual of the nominal vehicle is measured against the IMU and the pack telemetry, the direction of the residual names the fault, and three detectors are tuned to the same false-alarm budget before their detection delays are compared. What the vehicle actually is, is then identified in flight -- mass, inertia and drag area by recursive least squares from the commands, the IMU and the GPS, starting from a declaration twice too heavy -- the wind and the ground effect the nominal model is missing are learned on flights outside the nominal and measured on flights never seen, and the whole thing is quoted as a confidence horizon in seconds: how long the model answers for before its residual crosses the fault threshold.

metrics.how: BEMT of the 10x4.7 rotor at 6 000 rpm, against the momentum-theory ideal

metrics.name: hover_power
metrics.how: pack power at the hover speed of the 1.5 kg quad (9.1 g/W)

metrics.name: closed_loop_hover_error
metrics.how: mean position error over the last 40 % of a 20 s hover, 500 Hz

metrics.name: payload_residual
metrics.how: vertical force residual 2 s after a 0.4 kg payload, against g*0.4/1.5 = -2.61 predicted

metrics.name: kalman_false_alarms
metrics.how: fraction of fault-free flights the tuned detector alarmed on, flights it never saw

metrics.name: kalman_median_delay
metrics.how: median over the cases it detected

metrics.name: identified_mass_error
metrics.how: worst of the three identification flights, each started from a declaration twice too heavy (hover, a circle at 2.5 m/s and a figure-eight maneuver, 20 s at 200 Hz)

metrics.name: identified_yaw_inertia_error
metrics.how: the yaw inertia after the maneuver, against 0.021 kg m^2; after a hover the same estimate is 68 % wrong with a +-63 % uncertainty

metrics.name: identified_drag_area_x_error
metrics.how: the drag area along body x after the maneuver, against CdA = 0.030 m^2

metrics.name: ground_effect_transfer
metrics.how: force-residual rms on a flight through the ground-effect skirt it was never fitted on, over the same residual before the correction

metrics.name: wind_as_a_state_transfer
metrics.how: force-residual rms on an 8 m/s gust it was never fitted on, with the wind estimated causally per flight

metrics.name: wind_as_a_coefficient_penalty
metrics.how: the same residual on a flight with no wind when the wind is one coefficient fitted across the gusts: it makes it worse

metrics.name: confidence_horizon_after_a_maneuver
metrics.how: the model a maneuver taught, answering for the same flight a hover-taught model answers 1.7 s for (sigma 0.041 against 0.267 m/s^2)
